title: Halden Vault's drive replacements for 2026-Q4 to 2027-Q3: the quarterly path with its range, the fourth quarter's spare order and the HX-8 bad builds' migration
domain: General Statistics & Data Science, Bayesian modeling & posterior inference
task_type: Bayesian modeling and posterior inference (a posterior predictive forecast of replacement counts from a hierarchical hazard model)

sources.origin: written for this task. Halden Vault, Brightstore, Kestrel Data Products, Meridian, Tamsin, Borealis, the drives, vaults, tickets and paperwork are invented; the fleet is simulated day by day per vault (manufacture batches and deploy lags, family wear-out hazards with an infant term, vault and batch frailty, one manufacturing window whose hazard ramps with age, chassis power and cooling incidents, SMART precursors and two health-pull policies, replacements into the same slot, selective decommissioning, and an acquired data centre whose records start at its migration), and every record is written from that process.
